messages:
olivia: Heads-up — PR #14218 is blocked by an intermittent integration test failure in `payment-e2e` and I'm worried about the upcoming deploy freeze at 18:00 UTC. Can anyone spare a short rebase slot today so we can land before freeze?

ci-bot: CI pipeline for PR #14218 started: https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/14218 — currently queued (position 7). Tests: unit ✓, integration ✗ (flaky).

matt: @olivia what's the failing test? Is it new flakiness or a regression from your changes?

olivia: @matt looks flaky — `payment_integration::refund_flow` times out ~30s on linux-4 runners. I ran it locally a few times and could repro ~1/6 runs. No direct code change to that area, probably test environment sensitivity. Log snippet: ```TimeoutError: refund flow exceeded 60s
  at tests/payment/refund.test:124:12```

jen: If it's flaky, we usually don't block the whole merge queue unless it's a release-critical PR. Is this cut for tomorrow's canary?

olivia: It's a hotfix for a billing edge-case customer reported today — want it in tonight's deploy because it affects failed invoices. So prefer to land before freeze.

sanjay: I can free up a 10-15m window around 17:30 UTC to help with reruns and quick debugging. If we can get a rebase slot and a focused rerun we might make it.

matt: +1 for a short slot. CI backpressure is real though — queue length spikes during peak. Do we need a full rebase or can we try re-running the failing job only?

olivia: Tried re-run job, fails intermittently. Plan: (1) rebase onto main to pick up infra flake fixes, (2) single-job rerun for `payment-e2e`, (3) if still failing, we can force-merge behind an agreed canary and rollback plan.

qa-team: We can stand by for quick canary verification if you land with a canary tag. How fast can you smoke-test after merge? 10-15m.

matt: Ok — propose a mini rebase slot at 17:30 UTC. @eng-releases: if anyone else has urgent merges, please chime in. Otherwise @olivia, rebase and ping here when done, and we will accelerate the `payment-e2e` job.

olivia: Rebase started — will push shortly. Will ping when pipeline triggers. Thanks @sanjay and @jen. :raised_hands:

ci-bot: New push to PR #14218 detected, pipeline queued (position 3). Jobs: unit ✅ , integration (payment-e2e) in progress.

ci-bot: `payment-e2e` job succeeded on attempt 2. All checks passed.

matt: Great — looks green. @olivia do you want a canary rollout first or full deploy?

olivia: Let's do a canary (5% traffic) and monitor invoices for 15m, then promote. Kicking off canary now.

jen: Noted. I will watch the error budget and logs. Good job team. :thumbsup:
